rationale: Add one export-side FP16 keep for the penultimate recurrent tail value projection. The current best is near the size cap and recurrent value-path float rescue has been one of the closer local signals; this spends a small amount of remaining artifact headroom while preserving the proven reverse-tail recurrence, training loop, final exact evaluation, and quant-aware endgame.
title: Penultimate Recurrent Value FP16 Rescue
